newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hewlett-Packard sees continued Asia growth.
newsitem.headline: Hewlett-Packard sees continued Asia growth.

text.p: Computer giant Hewlett-Packard Co said on Thursday it expects its Asia-Pacific turnover to continue to grow at around 30 percent a year.

Alan Bickell, senior vice president and managing director of worldwide geographic operations, told reporters Hewlett-Packard's turnover in the Asia-Pacific region had been about US$5 billion in 1995 out of a total worldwide of around US$31.5 billion, and its growth for the region was in excess of 30 percent a year.
"I don't see that changing too much," he said.

Bickell, in Singapore to open the company's new Singapore $250 million factory, said the Asia-Pacific region was growing so rapidly because many of the company's new products were being developed there.
The factory is producing hand-held computers, calculators, and printers.
